scope: 1214fq (protocol 80, #132): 1214fp plus the breakable stream. Each world catalogs its arkBreakable entities and polls their steps; a step that advanced locally is sent once with the native hit noted by the damage observer, and the peer advances its copy to that step through the native step advance (1407ed000) with default sword damage params carrying the hit, then lowers its health to the step threshold. Breaks only go forward and an applied step counts as sent. coop_breakable_sync on/off, product step 21; probe --breakables; unit tests cover the packet, the step rule and the reader.
